lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Stop. You're rambling again. Tell me about a time you solved a problem.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay, okay. So at Dune and Co., we were gonna miss a big deadline, right?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Better. But what was YOUR role in that? Be specific.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I led it. I broke the task down, and we delivered two days early.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Hm. Honestly? That was strong.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا صَحْبِي!... أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاك فِي يَلَّا فْلُوئِنْت. النَّهَارْدَه مَعَانَا مُقَابَلَة وِهْمِيَّة، مَكَّال وَطَارِق بِيتْدَرَّبُوا... وَالدَّرْس كُلُّه عَنْ إِزَّاي تْرُدّ مِن غِير مَا تْتْلَخْبِط.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خَلِّي وَدْنَك مَعَايَا... وَاسْمَع تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات: Tell me about a time، أَيْ حِكِي لِي عَنْ مَرَّة... وَ STAR method، يَعْنِي تِرْتِب قِصَّتَك... وَآخِر وَاحْدَة: Could you clarify، لَمَّا تِحْتَاج تِسْأَل تَوْضِيح.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا... نِسْمَع مَكَّال بِيِتْحَسَّن شُوَيَّة شُوَيَّة. رَكِّز مَعَايَا، وَدُوس بْلَاي!

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Alright, reset. This time I'll be the interviewer from Rising Voices. No mercy.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: No mercy? Fine. Hit me. I've been prepping all week — I even record myself at night.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Good. So — tell me about a time you had to handle a difficult teammate.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sure. So last quarter, two people on my team weren't speaking to each other. The work was stalling. I set up a short call, just the three of us. I asked each one what they needed. Turns out it was a misunderstanding about roles. We fixed it in one meeting, and the project moved again. My role? I was the one who pushed to talk it out early.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Okay. That's clean. Situation, task, action, result. You actually used the STAR method without sounding like a robot.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I live here since two years — so I've had practice, believe me.
lines.direction: relaxed, slight laugh — the small slip goes unnoticed by him

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Good. Now I'm gonna throw you a curve. What's your biggest weakness?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hm. Honestly? I used to say yes to everything. I thought it made me useful. Then I missed a deadline because I took on too much. Now I ask more questions before I commit.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Wait — before you answer something like that, you should ask what they mean. 'Could you clarify what kind of weakness?' It buys you a second and shows you're careful.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Right. Could you clarify... okay, I'll use that next time. That's smart.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: I'm not saying this to be nice, but — you've gotten better. Like, actually better.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That means a lot, coming from you. Seriously. Let's do one more — I wanna nail this.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا صَحْبِي، نِفَكِّك سَوَا... أَوَّل تَعْبِير: Tell me about a time. يَعْنِي حِكِي لِي عَنْ مَرَّة، وِدِي أَكْتَر سُؤَال بِيتْكَرَّر فِي المُقَابَلَات. بِيِسْتَخْدِمُوه عَشَان يِشُوفُوا إِنْتَ عَمَلْت إِيه بِالظَّبْط، مِش إِنْتَ مِين. مَثَلًا: Tell me about a time you solved a problem.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي تَعْبِير... الـ STAR method. يَعْنِي تِرْتِب قِصَّتَك: Situation، وَبَعْدِين Task، وَبَعْدِين Action، وَآخِر حَاجَة Result. مَكَّال عَمَلْهَا بْرَاحَة فِي المَشْهَد، وِعَشَان كِدَه طَلَع كَلَامُه مُرَتَّب مِن غِير مَا يْبَان رُوبُوت.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وِتَالِت تَعْبِير: Could you clarify? يَعْنِي تِسْأَل تَوْضِيح. لَمَّا السُّؤَال يْكُون غَامِض، مَتْرُدّش عَلَطُول... بِسْأَل: Could you clarify what you mean? كِدَه بِيكْسَبك ثَانْيَة، وَبْيُورِّي إِنَّك دَقِيق.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَمَّا الغَلْطَة... مَكَّال قَال: I live here since two years. دِي جَايَة مِن العَرَبِي عَشَان إِحْنَا بْنِقُول: أَنَا عَايِش هِنَا مِن سَنَتِين. بِس فِي الإِنْجِلِيزِي، لَمَّا تِتْكَلِّم عَن حَاجَة بَدْأَت فِي المَاضِي وِلِسَّه مُسْتَمِرَّة، بْنِسْتَخْدِم: I've lived here for two years. خَلِّي بَالَك: for، مِش since، مَعَ المُدَّة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَقْتِي... الـ Accent Lab! النَّهَارْدَه عَنْ Sentence stress — يَعْنِي فِي الإِنْجِلِيزِي، بِنْضَغَط عَلَى الكَلِمَات المُهِمَّة: الأَسْمَاء، الأَفْعَال، الصِّفَات... وِبْنِبْلَع الكَلِمَات الصَّغِيرَة زَي the، of، to، a.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: هَات جُمْلَة مِن المَشْهَد: I was the one who pushed to talk it out early. المُصْرِي بِيقُول كُل كِلْمَة بِنَفْس القُوَّة... I-was-the-one-who-pushed. غَلَط! الأَمْرِيكِي بِيعْمِل: I was the ONE who PUSHED to TALK it OUT EARly. جَرِّب مَعَايَا... دُوس عَلَى ONE، PUSHED، TALK، OUT، EARly. كَرِّر بَعْدِي!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بْرَافُو يَا بَطَل! حِسِّت الفَرْق؟ كِل مَرَّة تِرْكِّز عَلَى الوَقْت، لُغَتُك تِطْلَع أَكْتَر طَبِيعِيَّة. يَلَّا نِرْجَع لِلْقِصَّة... مَكَّال وَطَارِق لِسَّه فِي التَّدْرِيب!

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: One more. And this time, you ask the questions too. An interview goes both ways.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Deal. So — tell me about a time your team disagreed with your plan. And, could you clarify what you mean by 'disagreed'?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Look at you. You turned my own trick around.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I've lived here for two years, habibi. I learn fast.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Ha. Yeah. You do.
lines.direction: laughs, then it fades; a long pause, the smile leaving his face, a slow breath before he lets his guard down

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: That was — actually clean. Okay. Honestly? I've been hard on you because I was scared. You're catching up. Fast.
lines.direction: quiet now, the joking gone; honest and a little vulnerable

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Scared of what?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: My father's sick back in Cairo. I might need to go. And if I leave, you're the one they'll pick for the fellowship.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Tarek... I didn't know. That's not a race for me. If you need anything, I'm here.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Thanks. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا بَطَل، نِلَخَّص بِسُرْعَة... النَّهَارْدَه خَدْنَا تَلَات تَعْبِيرَات: Tell me about a time، عَشَان تِحْكِي قِصَّة مُرَتَّبَة... والـ STAR method، وَهِيَ Situation وَ Task وَ Action وَ Result... وَ Could you clarify، عَشَان تِسْأَل تَوْضِيح بِلُطْف!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة... هِيَ: Tell me about a time. دِي أَكْتَر جُمْلَة هَتْسَمْعَهَا فِي المُقَابَلَة، فَخَلِّي صَوْتُك حَاضِر، وَبِدَايَة قِصَّتِك وَاضْحَة.
lines.direction: slow, emphatic on the English phrase, inviting

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَقْتِي، التَّحَدِّي... سَجِّل رِسَالَة صَوْتِيَّة قَصِيرَة، قُول فِيهَا Tell me about a time، وَرَكِّز عَلَى النَّبْر عَلَى TIME، وَابْعَتَهَا لِنَا عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام فِي مَجْمُوعَة Empire English Community.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: إِحْنَا هَنِسْمَع صَوْتُك، وَنِشَجِّعُك... وَمَتْخَافِش مِن الغَلَط، كِدَه بِنِتْعَلِّم! يَلَّا، مُسْتَنِّيك بُكْرَة فِي الحَلْقَة الجَايَة... سَلَام!
lines.direction: encouraging, big brother warmth, ending bright

phonetic_focus.note: Stress the content words (nouns, verbs, adjectives) and swallow the function words (the, of, to, a). This gives English its rhythm.
